blocks.text: LAPU-LAPU CITY, Cebu — The Cebu Provincial School Board (CPSB) has approved ₱51.6 million in additional funding for the Department of Education (DepEd) Cebu Province, covering temporary learning shelters and a second provincial sports and cultural meet this year. The supplemental allocation comes as the DepEd Cebu Schools Division works under a revised school calendar that has created additional funding requirements for activities and preparations. Lawyer Roy Salubre, Cebu provincial treasurer, said the CPSB had ₱1.5 billion in its trust fund as of July 31 when Gov.
